setup: Session A (fresh Claude Code agent session, OrgX connector) recorded decision/artifact/receipt via OrgX. Session B ran in a fresh, empty workspace with OrgX enabled; verbatim continuation prompt.
failure_analysis: Server-side outage, not a missing record. Every MCP tool response was rejected by the client with 'MCP error -32602: Structured content does not match the tool's output schema' — the server registered its default output schema as a raw zod shape, which compiles to additionalProperties:false, so every rich structuredContent payload violated the server's own advertised schema. Writes landed before responses failed (Session A hit the same bug as 500s and its retries created 4 duplicate decision rows, cleaned up in-session). The records verifiably existed; Session B could not read them. Fixed the same day in useorgx/orgx-mcp#262; run 3 is the post-fix re-run. This failed run is published because a benchmark that hides its own product's outage is not a benchmark.
